اتمأررت (form IVq)
# اِتْمَأْرَرْتُ (itmaʔrartu) /it.maʔ.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# اِتْمَأْرَرْتَ (itmaʔrarta) /it.maʔ.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# اِتْمَأْرَرْتِ (itmaʔrarti) /it.maʔ.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
